title: Titan Market Maker - Portfolio config
description: Titan Market Maker — unified portfolio app config.

wallets.description: Named signer wallets; `wallet` selects the portfolio signer.

^(.*)$.description: Named signer wallet. Referenced by venue.wallet.

privateKey.description: Hex-encoded ECDSA private key for the signer.

wallet.description: Key in `wallets` for the single shared signer. All venues submit through this one account/nonce.

name.description: Chain id (hardhat, base-sepolia, base, arbitrum). Resolves the viem chain object.

rpcUrl.description: JSON-RPC endpoint URL for reads and tx submission.

ethPriceFeed.description: Optional Chainlink ETH/USD aggregator. Required for USD-denominated gas budgets; leave empty for local hardhat.

venues.description: Venues to run in this process (perps and/or futures).

maxPositionSize.description: USD. Per-venue net position cap for perps.

strategy.description: Pricing strategy. Perps lock to 'effective-spread' (symmetric mid-spread).

minSpreadBps.description: Floor on the half-spread in bps. Quotes never tighten below this.

volatilityMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to realized volatility when widening the spread.

inventorySkewGamma.description: Inventory skew coefficient. Quotes shift by γ × (netPos / maxPos) ticks toward unwinding.

maxSkewTicks.description: Cap on absolute ticks a level can be skewed from the symmetric mid.

strategy.description: Sizing strategy. Perps lock to 'linear' (level k receives (k+1) × baseQuantity).

baseQuantity.description: Per-level base size in venue-native units (perps: hashrate base units). Use a string for values > 2^53.

numLevelsPerSide.description: Number of price levels quoted per side.

anyOf.description: Futures venue (one market per selected expiry).

maxPositionSize.description: USD. Per-expiry net position cap for futures markets.

marketSelection.description: Which futures expiries to quote: 'nearest' N dates, or explicit 'indices' into the nearest-first window.

strategy.description: Pricing strategy. Futures lock to 'reservation-price' (Avellaneda–Stoikov inventory skew).

riskAversion.description: Avellaneda–Stoikov risk aversion γ. Higher = stronger inventory skew.

marginCallTimeSec.description: Seconds. Fallback time-to-margin-call when InstrumentContext.expirationAt is unavailable.

minSpreadBps.description: Floor on the half-spread in bps. Quotes never tighten below this.

volatilityMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to realized volatility when widening the spread.

maxSkewTicks.description: Pinned to 0 — under reservation-price the skew is encoded in r itself.

strategy.description: Sizing strategy. Futures lock to 'geometric-taper' (front level largest, decays by taperRatio).

baseQuantity.description: Total per-side budget in venue-native units (futures: contract base units). Distributed via taperRatio. Use a string for values > 2^53.

numLevelsPerSide.description: Number of price levels quoted per side.

taperRatio.description: Geometric decay ratio in (0, 1). Each subsequent level is taperRatio × the previous.

risk.description: Risk caps, circuit-breakers, and gas-price guards.

maxPositionSize.description: USD. Hard cap on |net position notional|. Beyond this, only risk-reducing quotes are placed.

maxUtilizationPct.description: Margin utilization (used IM / vault balance) above which only risk-reducing quotes are placed.

minCollateralBalance.description: USD. Operational floor; halts quoting when vault balance falls below this.

maxDailyLossUsd.description: USD. Daily PnL circuit-breaker. Halts quoting when realized loss + gas exceeds this since 00:00 UTC.

maxGasBudgetPerHourUsd.description: USD. Soft throttle: when hourly gas spend exceeds this, requote cooldown triples.

maxGasBudgetPerDayUsd.description: USD. Hard halt: stops requoting once daily gas spend exceeds this.

gasSpikeThresholdPct.description: Percent of baseline. Quotes pause when current gas price exceeds (baseline × pct/100).

gasPenaltyBps.description: Bps to widen spreads by per unit of gas-cost-as-fraction-of-notional (compensates for fill economics).

urgentRequoteThresholdTicks.description: Tick distance from oracle at which a stale order is requoted immediately, ignoring cooldown.

gasCapMultiplier.description: Multiplier on viem-suggested gas price for the maxFeePerGas cap. Higher = more reliable inclusion at higher cost.

autoDeposit.description: If true, sweeps wallet token balance into the vault on each loop iteration (subject to min/max).

autoDepositMinAmount.description: USD. Trigger threshold: deposit fires only when wallet balance ≥ this. Dust filter to avoid wasting gas on tiny sweeps.

maxCollateralAmount.description: USD. Optional ceiling on the total vault balance held by this MM. Each auto-deposit brings the vault up to (but not above) this value; the wallet retains anything beyond it. Omit for no ceiling.

windowSize.description: Number of de-duplicated price samples retained for realized-vol estimation. 60 is enough for a ±9% standard error on σ; tune up for smoother σ at the cost of slower regime tracking.

precisionBits.description: Bits of fractional precision for the bigint ln/sqrt approximations underpinning σ. 48 is plenty for vol math; raise only if a strategy demonstrably needs more.

historyLookbackMultiplier.description: Backfill fetches `windowSize × multiplier × pollInterval` of history from the subgraph, then trims duplicates. Multiplier > 1 absorbs Chainlink's slow update cadence so the window arrives full.

history.description: Historical price source for σ window backfill.

subgraphUrl.description: GraphQL endpoint for the hashprice-oracle subgraph (queries the HashpriceUsd time-series). Empty string is treated as 'no source' so YAML can use ${VAR:-} patterns; omit the entire `history` block for the same effect.

pollIntervalSec.description: Seconds between main-loop iterations (snapshot, quote, execute).

requoteThresholdTicks.description: Tick deviation from current target before a resting order is replaced.

requoteCooldownSec.description: Seconds between requote bursts. Tripled when risk is throttled.

resyncIntervalSec.description: Seconds between full BookTracker snapshot refetches (event deltas in between).

levelSpacingTicks.description: Ticks between successive quote levels. 1 = quote every tick, 5 = every fifth.

port.description: TCP port for the /healthz HTTP endpoint.

maxCallsPerTx.description: Max cost units per tx before chunking (not raw call count).

confirmationTimeoutSec.description: Seconds to wait for a tx receipt before replacing by fee.

maxReplacements.description: Replacement-by-fee attempts before escalating to a cancel-tx.

replacementFeeBumpPct.description: Fee bump per replacement attempt, percent.

maxNonceResyncs.description: Per-submit retries that re-read the chain nonce when another party (e.g. a keeper sharing this wallet) advances it. Workaround for a shared signer.

rollCheckIntervalSec.description: Seconds between futures roll re-checks (add/drop expiries).

sharedStalenessGraceSec.description: Seconds shared inputs may be stale before new placements are paused (existing orders kept).
